reasons: Status is correctly 'missing': the cited Section 9 provisions are for-cause only (breach, insolvency, specific Vendor failures), and with a three-year term plus a take-or-pay commitment stated to be without reduction or termination rights, the absence of any Customer convenience exit is walk-away territory under T4C.

The inserted Section 9.4 tracks the rule's model language closely (30 days' written notice, whole or in part, refund of prepaid Fees for the post-termination period) and adds only what is needed to make the right effective (override of Section 2.1's no-termination language, no early-termination penalty) plus the express bar on Vendor convenience termination required by the preferred position.
Placement immediately after 9.3 within the termination article is coherent, the original paragraph text is left unchanged, and both deterministic checks pass.
Comment is accurate, in the required voice and prefix, explains the change and cites the playbook position, and offers the 60-day fallback without lecturing.
